description: This file provides re-exports of various modules related to gateway and client functionality, including channel status patches, gateway client, operator approvals client, and event frame protocol types. It acts as an index or aggregator for gateway-related components used by plugins to communicate with the host gateway surface.

methods.name: GatewayClient
methods.description: The GatewayClient class, which provides communication methods for the gateway.

methods.name: createOperatorApprovalsGatewayClient
methods.description: A factory function to create a GatewayClient configured for operator approvals.
